findings.message:
This can be a bit more specific to make sure we reject things like control characters.

```suggestion
            assert!(LETTER_E.is_ascii_alphabetic(), "non-alphabetic character");
```
findings.tp_fp_justification: tgross35: is_ascii is too broad for the digit/letter check; is_ascii_alphabetic is required, otherwise non-alphabetic ASCII bytes pass the check and produce wrong formatting output.
tgross35: unreachable_unchecked relies on exp < 100 which is not statically guaranteed; a const assert on ilog10 < 100 is needed to make the unsafe precondition hold.
